title: Automix transition plan
description: What the planner decides for one transition (src/automix/automix.js plan() and planLoopMix()). Times are seconds of each song's own timeline; 'out' is the playing song, 'in' the next one. The golden files in spec/automix/golden hold one of these per engine version.

pos.description: Playhead of the outgoing song when the plan was made.

earliest.description: Earliest mix-out: pos + the hand-over lead (4 s) + 0.5 s.

plays.description: What the player plays: the loop mix when it found bars on both sides, else blend.style. Its curves are loop.curves or blend.curves.

points.description: [[t, value], ...], t ascending, seconds from the transition's start (may be negative: the outgoing song's speed-up before a blend). Held before the first point and after the last; linear between points, except Hz curves, which move geometrically; a step is two points at the same t.

deckCurves.description: One song's moves. An absent curve stays neutral: lowpassHz 20000, highpassHz 20, bassDb 0, highDb 0, rate 1.

gain.description: Fader, 0..1 (on top of the song's own volume and levelling).

rate.description: Playback rate (tempo and pitch together, or time-stretched on a stretch deck).

curves.description: What each song does over the transition, emitted by the planner and played by the engine (automix.js blendCurves / loopCurves). The overview draws these, so both apps draw the same thing whatever the engine version. 'out' is the playing song, 'in' the next one.

bars.description: Loop length; 4 is tried first, then 2, then 1.

vocal.description: Share of the loop that is sung (must stay under 0.03, no sung run over 0.2 s).

checkedBy.description: Sung spans from synced lyrics, or the open-unmix mask when the song has none.

loopPlan.description: The loop mix. null: no usable grid or a music video. {none}: a side has no instrumental bars.

fold.description: Tempo fold (0.5, 1 or 2) so the ramp is the shortest between the two BPMs.

enterBars.description: Bars the incoming loop plays in, bass cut, at the outgoing tempo.

rampBars.description: Bars of the master tempo ramp (at most 2.5 BPM per bar).

curves.description: t = 0 is the outgoing loop's start.

style.description: blend: beatmatched EQ blend. filter: incoming at its own tempo, low-passed, outgoing high-passed. crossfade: 12 s equal-power fade, the fallback.

reason.description: Why a filter mix or crossfade was chosen instead of a blend.

clash.description: Share of the blend where both songs sing (version 2).

rerouted.description: Version 2: how the blend point moved to sing less over each other, or why it could not.

vocalsBy.description: What the clash was measured with.

keyClash.description: 'F major → B minor' when the keys clash and key-aware mixing is on; then the blend is shortened.

mixOutTrackTime.description: Outgoing song time where the transition starts.

mixInTrackTime.description: Incoming song time it starts from.

rate.description: Incoming playback rate during the blend.

outRate.description: Outgoing rate after the tempo ramp.
